name: Pigeon
summary: Flutter's code generator for structured, type-safe communication between Dart and host-platform code over platform channels.
advantages: Generates structured type-safe host/client messaging code
Eliminates manual string matching for method names and message types
tradeoffs: Adds a generator workflow and generated native/Dart code
Supported targets and generated APIs must be kept aligned with the package version
recommendedFor: SDK or plugin development where Dart/native contracts should be generated
Projects that want to avoid handwritten method-name and payload matching

verification.reason: Flutter official documentation and current pub.dev metadata are sufficient.
